new_content.name: Suspicious Clay, Dirt, Mud, Packed Mud, Red Sand, Rooted Dirt, Soul Sand, Soul Soil
new_content.how_to_obtain: Found in the world as small rare deposits (e.g. clay near rivers and beaches, soul sand in Soul Sand Valley); not crafted.
new_content.notes: Brushed with a brush like vanilla suspicious sand/gravel to reveal loot; sand-like variants fall as gravity blocks. Loot is table-driven and datapack-customizable.

new_content.name: Gentle Touch
new_content.how_to_obtain: Not stated in facts; check enchanting/villager trades in-game.
new_content.notes: Can give a second drop from a block (see 'Lucky Block' advancement). Exact effect to verify.

mechanics.title: Brushing
mechanics.description: Equip a brush and hold right-click on a suspicious block to excavate it.

mechanics.title: Advancements
mechanics.description: Five advancements: root 'Dig a little deeper', First Dig (use a brush), Preservationist (collect every pottery sherd), Interdimensional Archaeology (brush a suspicious block in the Nether), Lucky Block (second drop via Gentle Touch).

vanilla_changes.change: 20% chance of offering a random pottery sherd for 8 emeralds and a brick.
Many more brushable suspicious block types generate in the world.

getting_started: Carry a brush and look for suspicious blocks in rivers, beaches, mud areas and the Nether.
editor_notes: Enchantment description not in readme; verify Gentle Touch in-game.
name: Archaeology Tweaks
summary: Extends vanilla archaeology beyond suspicious sand and gravel. New brushable suspicious blocks generate naturally as small deposits in fitting biomes, plus a new enchantment, advancements and a wandering trader trade for pottery sherds. Written by the pack author.
